Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
GAME: PEAK v0.3.1, first-person climbing. Title→Space→menu; PLAY OFFLINE sometimes needs two clicks; initial load ~50 host steps. Esc pause shows BACK/ACCOLADES/SETTINGS/REBIND/LEAVE; no restart/respawn seen. Each action appears to advance only ~1s host time regardless of requested duration (guess from step behavior).

CONTROLS (observed): WASD move; arrows look (0.15–0.6s taps fine aim; ~0.5s Right ≈30–45°; 1.5–2s ≈60–90°; 2.5–3s ≈180°); Space jump; Ctrl crouch; Shift sprint/lunge; E interact (needs QUICK TAP, not hold); Q drop, Q hold = throw; J item action (passport 'open J', binoculars 'look J', lollipop 'lick J') and also climb latch; M ping, R emote, V push-to-talk; 1 equip/stow passport (hands must be EMPTY to climb); 2/3 item slots; Esc pause.

STAMINA (observed): bar bottom-left, green current + dark tail; fully dark = exhausted (grabs show red X, slide). Idle regen ~7–12%/s; from full exhaustion ~40% by 6s, ~80–90% by 11–13s. Gripping stalls regen. S releases grip → fast regen (releasing atop a column left player standing on a ledge). Shift lunge costs ~25–40% and only works from a grip; lunge at exhaustion gives red X, no fall. Repeated W+J pulls cost ~half a bar on some walls (~4 pulls = exhaustion).

CLIMB (observed): target must be near screen center and not pressed against wall; W+J latches, repeated W+J ratchets up; Space from a grip adds height and worked where Shift+J gained nothing. Blue-trimmed surfaces/copings/panels latch; blank white tile, plain column faces, bare speckled panel backing, thin rims mostly fail. Pink hands = latch success; red X = rejected.

ITEMS: BIG LOLLIPOP (E pickup; licking at full stamina does nothing), BINOCULARS (J zoom, subtle), basketball ('BASKETBALL / E pick up'). Cream cylinder by plane is a trash bin, not a kiosk. Passport shows 'Fuye'.

NAVIGATION (observed): concourse with giant chess set (the 'penguin crowd' is chess pieces), DEPARTURES screens, ARRIVALS signs, palms/planters; GATE 7A NOW BOARDING with an oval porthole wall (rim ungrabbable); pool lanes with rope stanchions; basketball court (hoop, ball cart, BINGBONG screen, two yellow trampolines); escalator with green entry light (belt walkable; guard-rail loop needs a hop); upper balcony/walkway with white railing along right wall. Column climb by the court reaches a walkway behind the BINGBONG screen, then a terrace pool with yellow railings and blue-mosaic deck, a DEPARTURES board, then the roof: porthole wall (no holds), blue truss fence over cracked tarmac with yellow lines, distant plane tail/jet bridge, green curb (walking over it reaches the roof apron), plus a return route to the court's planter/plane area. A giant white studded cone/boulder with colored holds appears at pool edges and as wall panels; all grabs on it failed at every distance (may be decoration).

DEAD ENDS (confirmed): blue truss roof fence impassable (walk, hop, crouch, W+J); trampolines do not launch (tap or hold); spare blank-tile corners; inter-pillar gaps wedge the player; ceiling cavity at column tops is hollow with no exit; far end of basketball court is bare tiled wall; press-against-wall grabs always miss; W+D near pillars slides instead of advancing. USEFUL HABIT: back off with S then strafe; long strafes (2–2.5s) slip past the pink teammate better than forward pushes.

PINK TEAMMATE/NPC: hat, badge, passport sash; repeatedly re-centers in front of camera, sometimes blocks walking, sometimes floats; E does nothing, K gives arms-out 'helping hand' pose; hop (W+Space) clears it. Identity unresolved (prop vs bot).

BOARDING (observed, key progress): GATE KIOSK is an orange/black chevron-striped pillar with a blue-lit angled screen, on blue carpet near rope stanchions and a planter (escalator and colorful hold-walls beyond). Hovering the blue screen shows gold outline + 'GATE KIOSK / E board flight'. Long E holds (1.5s, 2s) did nothing; a QUICK E TAP (0.15s) opened a BOARDING PASS panel: passenger 'Fuye', GATE 7, FROM ACG TO LFG, difficulty 'PEAK - THE ISLAND'S DEFAULT DIFFICULTY', reward 'TADPOLE SCOUT', blue START button (hover turns yellow). Clicking START gave a gold star-burst transition, then a stylized globe flight-path screen (white plane with red trail along an arc, '???' destination marker, repeated 'LOADING...' text).

LOADING STATE (observed): ~185+ host steps stuck on that card; red trail tip static, sometimes stopping short of the right endpoint dot (~0.78, 0.71) — reads as looping/frozen animation, not a progress bar (unresolved). Inputs that did NOTHING on the overlay: left-click at center; right-click at (0.5,0.6); hover and click on '???' marker (retried at normalized ~0.655, 0.555; no highlight/tooltip); click on right endpoint dot; 0.6s drag 0.3→0.7 across canvas; drag from start dot (0.225, 0.715) along arc to '???' (1.0s); Space; Return; Space+Return; Escape (now FOUR separate probes, latest 0.2s after ~185 steps); E hold; W hold; J tap; slot key 1 tap; Tab tap (0.2s); scroll; many 5s waits (latest several in a row, no visible change).

SUSPICION (guess): the instance is permanently stalled on load (offline/network failure) and unrecoverable in-session; no in-game input affects the overlay.

SITUATION: terminal soft-lock at the boarding→island transition; episode effectively ended there. Marked terminal_candidate and requested compaction. Treat the boarded-load screen as the terminal observation if revisiting this instance. For a future attempt: skip roaming, go straight to the kiosk, quick-tap E, and be ready for the load hitch; if it stalls again the transition is the failure point.

UNRESOLVED: whether boarding START needs a second confirm; whether/when the island episode loads; whether the arc is real progress or a loop; whether START required passport held (it was stowed in slot 1 and still worked); whether the colorful hold-walls are climbable; whether pool water is swimmable; exact mouse-aim-to-climb mapping; whether the game is genuinely stuck vs. very slow network.
